source_rules.rationale: This proof-only rule asserts the general mathematical fact that slicing a string after two known leading codes yields its arbitrary symbolic tail. Stage 1 compiles the rule into VERIFICATION before proving the sole correctness claim, and prove.sh contains no earlier proof of this exact rule against a module that omits it, so the fact remains trusted.
source_rules.text:
rule doSlice(
         str(iCons(_FIRST:Int, iCons(_SECOND:Int, REST:IntSeq))),
         someB(2),
         noB,
         noB)
    => str(REST)
    [priority(40)]
